** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Position nonempty lines by their line index.** For `a\n\nb`, the empty middle `` has no character to position. Its `dy` does not reserve a line, so `b` appears one line too high. The export renderer repeats this calculation at `overlay-raster.ts` Line 100. Use an absolute `y` derived from `i` in both renderers so empty lines retain their spacing. ([w3.org](https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG/text.html))

After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Use multiline bounds for the double-click hit test.** When the user double-clicks a label’s second or later line, `hitTest` can return `null`. Its text branch still uses a one-line height at Line 489, although `OverlayShape` now draws every line. Measure the hit box with `textBoxPx` so every visible line can reopen the label.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Preserve leading and trailing line breaks on commit.** When a user inserts a trailing line break with Shift+Enter and then commits or blurs, `value.trim()` on the next line removes that break. The same call removes leading blank lines. These edits therefore cannot retain the line structure that `textLines` and `textBoxPx` support. Reject whitespace-only labels separately, but preserve the committed text.

** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Ignore Enter while an IME composition is active.** When an IME uses Enter to confirm a character, this handler prevents the key’s default action and commits the label before composition finishes. Check `e.nativeEvent.isComposing` before treating Enter as a commit. Based on learnings: Enter handlers must ignore IME confirmation unless they use a composition guard.
